author: PROnori
quote: Woke feminist fantasy game. The game is a open world real life simulator ( new IP ) which has nothing to do with heavy crime feeling like previous games. But I guess no one would be buying the game with the new name on it so they simply glued the GTA name on it to sell more. People who never played previous games are now telling all of you guys what the GTA game should be like, which in their mind is exactly this game.
